query: How did the engineering team perform this quarter according to the committee review?
answer: The quarterly review indicates that the customer engineering division performed exceptionally well under the guidance of Elena Rostova. The engineering team successfully overcame these bottlenecks to hit an unprecedented, record-high 12% growth rate on their core enterprise metrics.

knowledge_sources.content: The Executive Steering Committee reviewed the Q2 departmental performance metrics yesterday morning to calibrate budget allocations for the second half of the fiscal year. The growth data revealed starkly contrasting realities between the operational teams. The digital marketing department achieved an unprecedented, record-high 12% conversion rate on outbound lead generation campaigns, largely driven by their newly implemented automated AI-targeting framework. Conversely, the technical support and customer engineering division struggled heavily due to severe engineering resource constraints and a backlog of unassigned critical system bugs. These technical bottlenecks ultimately resulted in a highly disappointing 4% retention growth rate among enterprise-tier accounts, missing the company's baseline performance target by nearly half. Vice President of Operations, Elena Rostova, noted that while marketing is scaling rapidly, the engineering team requires immediate intervention, planning a hiring surge next month to alleviate the strain on developers and stabilize platform performance before the holiday traffic peak.
